description.zh: 泛在凭证所采用的LoRaWAN Class模式。取值：A、B、C。
description.en: The LoRaWAN Class mode used by the roaming join permission. Valid values: A, B, C.

description.zh: 当**ClassMode**取值为**B**时，设置期望下行速率，取值范围0~5。
description.en: The expected downlink data rate when **ClassMode** is set to **B**. Valid values: 0 to 5.

The frequency band ID used by the roaming join permission. Valid values:

- **102**: CN470 different frequency.
- **101**: CN470 same frequency.
- **201**: AS923 same frequency.

description.zh: 泛在凭证名称，支持中文、英文字母、数字和下划线（_），长度限制4～30个字符，一个中文占两个字符。
description.en: The name of the roaming join permission. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters.

description.zh: Class A的接收窗口延迟时间，取值范围1s~15s。
description.en: The receive window delay for Class A. Valid values: 1s to 15s.

title.en: Apply for a roaming join permission

descriptions.zh:
# 限制说明

- 单阿里云账号的泛在凭证数量为一个。
- 单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。

> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
# Before you begin

- Each Alibaba Cloud account can have only one roaming join permission.
- The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for this operation is 5.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
